missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Осень' is nominative as the subject of 'наступила'. 'Золотая' is the agreeing feminine adjective for the season.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Осень' is the accusative direct object of 'люблю'. As a feminine third-declension noun it looks identical to the nominative.

missions.phrase: В этом году не было осени.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Осени' takes the genitive after 'не было' to express the absence of autumn. 'В этом году' fixes the time.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of time. 'Осенью' is the instrumental form used adverbially to mean during autumn. 'Дождь' is the nominative subject of 'идёт'.

missions.phrase: Мы говорим об осени и зиме.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional topic. 'Осени' uses the prepositional form after 'об' to mark the topic. It is joined to 'зиме' by 'и'.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Осени' takes the dative after 'к' to mean by autumn. 'Школа' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Осени' is genitive linking to 'день' to mean a day of autumn. 'Последний тёплый' are agreeing masculine adjectives.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Осень' is nominative as the subject. 'Поздняя' and 'грустная' are agreeing feminine adjectives, and 'всегда' adds frequency.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after numeral. 'Осени' takes the genitive singular after 'три'. 'Прошло' is the neuter past of counting time.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of time with genitive. 'Осенью' is the instrumental adverb of season. 'Листья' is the nominative plural subject, and 'с деревьев' is the genitive plural source.
